summary__en: Steal an Egg's Halloween event is live. It adds the Halloween Dimension, an event zone with its own eggs and pets, including the Divine Voidseer Pumpkin and the Secret Grave Cerberus. The Enchanted Forest zone is in the game too. Part 1 went live on 17 Oct 2026 and the Roblox event page lists Part 2 for 24 Oct 2026. We added both zones to our lists on 23 Oct 2026. Event pets are marked limited.
source_note: Publish time from the Roblox games API (our update tracker); what the event adds is from the community wiki; release date 17 Oct 2026 from the Roblox event page (Ali, 2026-10-24)
